The generated model and data are fundamentally incorrect and cannot be fixed with minor edits. The model treats a dynamic problem as static, and the data for requirements is transposed. The only viable patch is to replace the entire content of both the model and data files with the correct versions.

**Replacement for the model file (`.mod`):**
```ampl
# model.mod  (Problem 12.5 / Section 13.5 cost objective)

param T integer > 0;
set YEARS  := 1..T;
set YEARS0 := 0..T;

set CATS;  # 1=Unskilled, 2=Semi-skilled, 3=Skilled

param strength      {CATS} >= 0;
param requirement   {CATS, YEARS} >= 0;

param lessonewaste  {CATS} >= 0, <= 1;
param moreonewaste  {CATS} >= 0, <= 1;

param recruit_cap   {CATS} >= 0;

param shorttime_cap >= 0;        # per category per year (50)
param overman_cap   >= 0;        # total per year (150)

param retrain_u_semi_cap  >= 0;  # up to 200 per year
param retrain_semi_s_frac >= 0, <= 1;  # <= 0.25 * skilled workforce

param costredundancy {CATS} >= 0;
param costoverman    {CATS} >= 0;
param costshort      {CATS} >= 0;

param costretrain_u_semi >= 0;   # 400
param costretrain_semi_s >= 0;   # 500

# Decision variables
var t {CATS, YEARS0} >= 0;   # workforce headcount at end of year
var u {CATS, YEARS}  >= 0;   # recruits
var w {CATS, YEARS}  >= 0;   # redundancies
var x {CATS, YEARS}  >= 0;   # short-time workers
var y {CATS, YEARS}  >= 0;   # overmanning (superfluous)

# Retraining
var v_u_semi {YEARS} >= 0;   # 1 -> 2
var v_semi_s {YEARS} >= 0;   # 2 -> 3

# Downgrading (50% leave, no direct cost)
var r_s_semi {YEARS} >= 0;   # 3 -> 2 (only 0.5 remain)
var r_s_u    {YEARS} >= 0;   # 3 -> 1 (only 0.5 remain)
var r_semi_u {YEARS} >= 0;   # 2 -> 1 (only 0.5 remain)

# Cost objective from the book (Section 13.5.2)
minimize TotalCost:
  sum {yr in YEARS} (
      costretrain_u_semi * v_u_semi[yr]
    + costretrain_semi_s * v_semi_s[yr]
    + sum {c in CATS} ( costredundancy[c] * w[c,yr]
                      + costshort[c]      * x[c,yr]
                      + costoverman[c]    * y[c,yr] )
  );

# Initial conditions
subject to InitStrength {c in CATS}:
  t[c,0] = strength[c];

# Recruitment caps
subject to RecruitCap {c in CATS, yr in YEARS}:
  u[c,yr] <= recruit_cap[c];

# Short-time caps
subject to ShortCap {c in CATS, yr in YEARS}:
  x[c,yr] <= shorttime_cap;

# Overmanning cap (total per year)
subject to OvermanCap {yr in YEARS}:
  sum {c in CATS} y[c,yr] <= overman_cap;

# Requirements (same algebra as the book)
subject to MeetRequirement {c in CATS, yr in YEARS}:
  t[c,yr] - y[c,yr] - 0.5*x[c,yr] = requirement[c,yr];

# Retraining caps
subject to RetrainUSemiCap {yr in YEARS}:
  v_u_semi[yr] <= retrain_u_semi_cap;

subject to RetrainSemiToSkilledLimit {yr in YEARS}:
  v_semi_s[yr] <= retrain_semi_s_frac * t[3,yr];

# Continuity constraints with wastage (same structure as Section 13.5.2)

# Skilled (3)
subject to BalanceSkilled {yr in YEARS}:
  t[3,yr] =
    (1 - moreonewaste[3]) * t[3,yr-1]
  + (1 - lessonewaste[3]) * u[3,yr]
  + (1 - moreonewaste[3]) * v_semi_s[yr]
  - r_s_semi[yr] - r_s_u[yr] - w[3,yr];

# Semi-skilled (2)
subject to BalanceSemi {yr in YEARS}:
  t[2,yr] =
    (1 - moreonewaste[2]) * t[2,yr-1]
  + (1 - lessonewaste[2]) * u[2,yr]
  + (1 - moreonewaste[2]) * v_u_semi[yr]
  - v_semi_s[yr]
  + 0.5 * r_s_semi[yr]
  - r_semi_u[yr]
  - w[2,yr];

# Unskilled (1)
subject to BalanceUnskilled {yr in YEARS}:
  t[1,yr] =
    (1 - moreonewaste[1]) * t[1,yr-1]
  + (1 - lessonewaste[1]) * u[1,yr]
  - v_u_semi[yr]
  + 0.5 * r_s_u[yr]
  + 0.5 * r_semi_u[yr]
  - w[1,yr];
```
